task.title: Add a family with children
task.shortdesc: Join two partners, record their marriage and add their children.

prereq.p: Add both partners first. shows how.

step.cmd: Open one of the partners, scroll down and choose . Then choose .

info.p: A person who is not in a family yet shows this button under . The sheet that opens has the choice Family ticked for you.

stepresult.p: A form opens. The person you came from is already in one of the partner boxes.

step.cmd: Select the other partner's box and type the name.

stepresult.p: A short list of people appears under the box.

step.cmd: Choose the person from the list.

info.p: The name only counts once you choose it from the list.

step.cmd: Scroll down and fill in and .

info.p: Leave them empty if you do not know them.

stepresult.p: A row appears for one child, with boxes for the names and the sex.

step.cmd: Type the child's names and choose the sex. Then choose for the birth date and for the birthplace.

stepresult.p: A small window opens for each. Fill it in and choose . The button then shows what you typed, or the start of it.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom and choose .

stepresult.p: The page of the family opens. It lists the partners, the marriage and the children.

result.p: Choose to see the family drawn out.

postreq.p: To change a family later, choose on its page. The form shows the partners and the marriage as you saved them.
